subject: social_studies
concept: Understanding that people live together in groups (families, neighborhoods, communities) and depend on each other
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CCE citizenship-taxonomy sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student identifies the different groups they personally belong to (family, class, neighborhood)
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a group of people to a way they depend on or help each other
exercise.abstract: Student explains, in their own words, why people live together in groups instead of alone

misconception_flags: cannot name any real way people in a group depend on each other

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
